## Research question

How have centuries of human land use shaped the biodiversity and landscapes we see today?

## About the project

MEMELAND investigates how historical land use has shaped European biodiversity over the last two millennia. By combining molecular evidence from lake sediments with archaeological and palaeoecological records, the project aims to distinguish local land-use histories from wider regional changes.

I am now involved in this collaboration, which connects my interest in sedimentary biomarkers with the long-term interactions between people, ecosystems, and landscapes.

## Approach

Paired lake-sediment archives, molecular proxies, and archaeological and palaeoecological evidence.
